title: The Former Tyre Shop on Rua Oscar Freire Where Natura Began
conflicts: Shop date: Natura's own timeline and 2009 report say the Oscar Freire shop opened in 1970, a year after the 1969 founding, while Brazil Journal and the International Directory of Company Histories imply it dates from the founding; the story opens in 1970. Seabra's job at founding: the IDCH says he was still an economist at Remington, his own interviews say he had managed a small cosmetics laboratory since 1966; the story follows his own account.
notes: Founder interviews are in Portuguese (Brazil Journal 2023, NeoFeed/Velvet 2025) and are paraphrased; the only direct quote is the IDCH's English rendering of his 1998 Exame remark. The $9,000 starting cash rests on the IDCH alone and is attributed. Quote stance: complicates (Saadi's honey-seller could sell poison by charm).
